_comment: Issue #136 codec parity fixtures. Sentinel refs/values only — no live ids, no secrets. Each case: legacy config + the depends_on keys and connector bindings its reverse mapping needs. 'bindings' maps operation_ref -> {connector_type, action_type}; 'fallback_target' re-synthesizes the legacy-required root target for self-terminating sequences (D2).

full_vocabulary_linear._comment: #184 amendment 3: Add to Cache (doccacheload / cache_put) and Remove from Cache (doccacheremove) hand on no documents, so nothing authored after them on their path runs; this linear case chained all three, which the builder now refuses at flow_sequence[7].kind. The linear chain keeps only the steps that are legal in a linear position, including both cache READ spellings (a read is triggered and hands on the cached documents). The cache writes are covered in their legal staging-leg form by cache_put_get, cache_load_retrieve_remove, decision_branch_map and root_branch_staging; the withdrawn linear chain is preserved as a refusal witness in tests/test_process_ir_flow_sequence_codec.py.

cache_load_retrieve_remove._comment: #184 amendment 3: this case chained doccacheload -> doccacheretrieve -> doccacheremove linearly. Add to Cache hands on no documents, so the read after it never ran (the builder refuses it at flow_sequence[1].kind), and Remove from Cache hands on none either. The legacy-spelled load and the explicit-default retrieve are kept in the legal ordered-leg form: a target-less staging leg ending at the load, then a later leg that reads and routes to its own target (legs run in authored order). The removal has NO legal flow_sequence placement at all — a leg ending in doccacheremove is refused too; ProcessIR authors it as a branch-leg terminal (golden 000082) — so it is preserved only as a refusal witness in tests/test_process_ir_flow_sequence_codec.py.

cache_put_get._comment: #184 amendment 3: this case chained cache_put -> cache_get linearly, which the builder now refuses at flow_sequence[1].kind (Add to Cache hands on no documents, so nothing arrives to trigger the read). The same put/get pair is kept in the legal ordered-leg form: a target-less staging leg ending at the cache_put, then a later leg whose cache_get reads what the earlier leg staged. The withdrawn linear pair is preserved as a refusal witness in tests/test_process_ir_flow_sequence_codec.py.

wrapper_process_calls._comment: #175: a wrapper parent is exactly ONE process call, and the call is the end of the path — no trailing Stop, and no Return Documents terminal (that would need the child to hand control back, which is the gated return-path binding, #176). The single call keeps every field variant the old two-call case covered: the $ref child token plus non-default wait/abort_on_error/label. The withdrawn multi-call and return_documents payloads are preserved as explicit negative cases in tests/test_process_ir_flow_sequence_codec.py and tests/test_wrapper_subprocess_builder.py.
